<subject>Re: Any Plans tonight?</subject>
<body>
Hey Shaun!  Sorry I didn't get back with you Friday.  I left a little early, so I must have just missed your message.  Did you guys have a good time on Friday night?  How is everything going?

It has actually been thick around here.  Worked several late nights last week to try and get caught up on the mortgage portfolio review and the Q1 lending forecasts.  We had a backlog on the corporate lending side that really piled up.  I may have to delay the purchase of the new car with Halcyon's stock taking a hit lately.  It did gain some points on Friday and early today.  Hopefully it keeps it up.  The Treasury team has been pretty optimistic about the next quarter, so fingers crossed the market stabilises.

The Credit Risk assessment we've been running has been consuming most of my time as well.  We're looking at some exposure issues with a couple of our commercial clients, nothing catastrophic but it requires careful monitoring.  Between that and the usual operational reviews, I've barely had time to breathe.  Shaun, if you do get a moment next week, I'd like to pick your brain about the deposit strategy we discussed before Christmas.  I think we might need to adjust our approach given the recent rate environment.

Talked to Max since his wedding?  Haven't heard anything out of him since.  Probably just overcome by marital bliss.  His wife seemed lovely from the photos.  I do hope they're settling in well down south.

Anyway, I'm keen to hear more about your evening plans.  Gilians sounds like a decent spot, and I'd be up for joining you lot if I can wrap up here at a reasonable hour.  Let me know what time you're heading out and I'll try to make it work.

Cheers,
Clifford Jones
Head of Operations
Halcyon Mutual Bank
Direct: +44 113 247 5891
Mobile: +44 7244 382092
</body>

Subject: Any Plans tonight?

Hey, what's going on?  My brother-in-law and a friend of his are flying into town tonight?  We're going to head over to Gilians (sp?), a place that is supposed to be like The Belgrave. We'll prob get there at about 10:00.  We thought we'd hang there for a while and then head to the city centre area and find some kind of bar.  A couple of other friends of mine from B-school will be joining us, I thought you might want to as well.  Are you game?

Write back or give me a call H: +44 7244 382092, cell: +44 20 2529 2161. I'm leaving work in a few minutes if I don't respond to any email.

later,
E

Subject: 2nd Room Confirmation

Clifford,

Good news - we were able to get the second room at the same £99 rate. Below you'll see two separate confirmation numbers - I don't think it matters which one you or I use.  When you check in, just claim one of them. They're both on my card so you can transfer to yours at check-in.

I'm not sure what time we'll get there since we'll be coming from Glasgow.  I estimate we'll get there at about 5:00 (the wedding is at 7:00 right?) We'll actually be traveling to Glasgow on Friday since some of Hilary's family from the west will be there as well.

If we're not in contact before then, let's just plan on meeting at the hotel sometime between 6:00 and 6:30.  We can drive over to the wedding together from there.

In case you didn't know, they're registered at John Lewis - we got him a gift yesterday, still plenty of items on the list.

E
